name: central-projects-tracking
description: Create a validated project-portfolio snapshot and complete private local tracking website from approved repositories and evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Build a safe central project tracking website
interface.longDescription: Inspect an explicitly approved local projects directory without mutating its repositories, combine bounded Git facts with allowlisted evidence, finalize a validated schema-v2 portfolio snapshot, and build a complete private local website with Brief, Portfolio, Activity, System, search, filters, accessible details, and Git change plans. Publishing, deployment, scheduling, and repository mutation remain separate.
defaultPrompt: Create a complete local Central Projects Tracking website for my approved portfolio.
Which local projects need attention, what evidence supports that, and what should happen next?
Refresh my validated project snapshot and rebuild the private local tracking site.
